server.name: com.usedailyai/meta-skill
server.description: The skill that creates skills

com.dailyaiagents.federation.full_description: The skill that creates skills. Reads a problem description, asks local Ollama to extract a skill spec (name, owner, pipeline, trigger, status codes), generates scaffolded SOUL.md + SKILL.md + run.sh, runs voice-gate + scrubber + bash-syntax + smoke on a synthetic input, lands the result in ~/.openclaw/skills/<name>/ if all checks pass or in data/proposed_skills/cont-17-meta/ if any fail. The runtime that writes its own tools, constrained to the SOUL+SKILL+run.sh schema and validated at every step.
